title: Show every flag state without losing retirement history

steps.action: Open a documented feature flag whose current state is on.
steps.expected_result: The flag is labeled on and still names what it gates.

steps.action: Open the same flag after an off lifecycle event.
steps.expected_result: The flag is labeled off and its earlier on event remains in history.

steps.action: Retire the flag and inspect both current release information and history.
steps.expected_result: The current release view labels or separates the retired flag while preserving every earlier event.

expected_result: A reader sees on, off, and retired states, and retirement remains inspectable history.
